exit 0
--- stdout
Initialize a new Liza workspace by creating .liza directory structure,
generating initial state.yaml, and setting up the integration branch.
The description argument is required and describes the goal.
The spec file (default: specs/vision.md) must exist and be fully committed
before initialization.
Use --config to provide a pipeline YAML file (defaults to ~/.liza/pipeline.yaml).
The config is validated and frozen into .liza/pipeline.yaml. Use --entry-point to
specify which entry-point to use (must be defined in the config).
Use --branch to set the integration branch name (default: "integration").
All worktrees branch from and merge back to this branch.
Use --post-worktree-cmd to specify a shell command that runs after every worktree
creation (e.g. 'make setup', 'npm install'). This ensures worktrees are
build/test-ready without hardcoding project-specific tooling into Liza.
For existing workspaces, use liza config get config.post_worktree_cmd or
liza config set config.post_worktree_cmd "<command>".
Use --copy-worktree-env-files to explicitly authorize copying ignored root env
files into task worktrees before post-worktree setup runs.
Use --max-instances to cap live agents per non-orchestrator role that does not
set its own max-instances (default 3). Auto-repair starts agents for claimable
work up to that cap; idle agents exit after doer_max_wait/reviewer_max_wait.
For existing workspaces, use liza config set config.max_instances <n>.
PAIRING MODE: Use agent flags without a description to create only the contract
symlinks needed for pairing (no .liza/ workspace):
liza init --claude # activates Claude's global contract
liza init --claude --codex # activates both global contracts and repo hooks
liza init --cursor # creates repo AGENTS.md plus dependent setup
liza init --opencode # activates OpenCode's global contract
liza init --copilot # activates Copilot's global instructions
Usage:
liza init [description] [flags]
Flags:
--agent-env-deny stringArray withhold a host variable from agents, their processes and copied env files (repeatable)
--auto-resume automatically resume at checkpoint and sprint completion
--branch string integration branch name (default "integration")
--claude activate the global Claude contract from ~/.liza/CORE.md
--codex activate the global Codex contract from ~/.liza/CORE.md and configure repo hooks
--config string path to pipeline YAML config file
--copilot activate the global GitHub Copilot CLI contract from ~/.liza/CORE.md
--copy-worktree-env-files copy ignored root env files into worktrees before setup commands
--cursor create the repo AGENTS.md contract and dependent Claude/Codex project setup
--default-cli string default CLI for agent spawning (built-in and catalog-backed providers; see 'liza providers list')
--default-doer-cli string default CLI for doer and orchestrator agent spawning (built-in and catalog-backed providers; see 'liza providers list')
--default-reviewer-cli string default CLI for reviewer agent spawning (built-in and catalog-backed providers; see 'liza providers list')
--entry-point string entry-point name: "general-objective", "functional-spec", "technical-spec", or legacy "detailed-spec" in default pipeline (default: auto-classified by orchestrator)
--gemini activate the global Gemini contract from ~/.liza/CORE.md
-h, --help help for init
--max-instances int default max live agents per non-orchestrator role without its own max-instances; auto-repair scales each role up to it (default 3)
--mistral set up ~/.vibe/ for Liza contract
--no-follow-up run only the entry-point subpipeline by suppressing top-level pipeline transitions
--opencode activate the global OpenCode contract from ~/.liza/CORE.md
--pi activate the global Pi contract from ~/.liza/CORE.md and install the pi init-gate extension
--post-worktree-cmd string shell command to run after worktree creation (e.g. 'make setup')
--provider stringArray activate provider catalog id (repeatable)
--scip-search stringArray enable a SCIP language for indexing (repeatable)
--scip-search-plan stringArray pairing SCIP root override: go=<module-root>, typescript=<cwd>,<project-root>, or python=<cwd>[,<target-only>] (repeatable)
--spec string path to goal spec file (default "specs/vision.md")
--validation-execution string "local": assert that the agent CLIs run validation commands locally, enabling declared validation prerequisites
--yes auto-confirm init prompts, including deletion of displayed existing workspace targets
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
--- stderr
